title: Matched causal-TCN reward pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Causal ordered action features improve PPO generalization over architecture-free head-only training across a fixed five-anchor opponent panel.
material_change: Matched 262144-hand control and causal-TCN treatment with a 122880-hand common-deck source/control/treatment matrix.
baseline: Causal-TCN smoke passed its fixed source point gate at -7.8024 bb/100; flat sequence matched treatment failed with only 2/5 positive anchors.
